ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’) · also + dat. of respect: ’in’ (ἐπὶ φρεσὶ … κέκασται ’excels in wits’) · also + gen., of range: ’as far as’ (ὅσον ἐπὶ δουρὸς ἐρωή ’as far as a spear’s rush carries’)
ἐρεβεννὴ: ἐρεβεννός — dark, murky; fem. nom. sg.
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’) · also + acc. of time: ’until’ (ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα ’until sunset’) · also + acc. of purpose: ’for’ (ἐς βρωτύν ’for food’)
ἐστυφέλιξε: στυφελίζω — strike, buffet, thrust back; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’struck, thrust back’
ἐών: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐών (= Attic ὤν): ’being’
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑκάβη: Ἑκάβη — Hecuba, wife of Priam; fem. nom. sg.
ἑλκόμενον: ἕλκω — drag, pull, trail; pres. part. mid./pass. neut. nom. sg.: ’being dragged, trailing’
ἑοῦ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive, epic enlarged ἑός) — his own, her own; masc. gen. sg. ἑοῦ, agreeing with παιδός
ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
ἔδονται: ἐσθίω — eat; fut. 3 pl., mid. in form (epic future)
ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἔθηκε: τίθημι — put, place, cause, bring about; aor. 3 sg., augmented (root θη-/θε-, consonant-initial; unaugmented θῆκε): ’set, caused’ (ἔριν ἔθηκε ’set strife’)
ἔκλυον: κλύω — hear, hearken to (+ gen.); aor. 3 pl. (also 1 sg.), in a general statement: ’they hear’ · also aor. 1 sg. + gen. of the speaker: ’I heard (it from one who told it)’ · also aor. 3 pl. + acc. of what is heard, in plain narrative: ’they heard’ (Ἕκτορος … αὐδήν ’Hector’s voice’)
ἔκπεσε: ἐκπίπτω — fall out, fall from; aor. 3 sg.: of a tear, ’fell from’ (+ dat. of the person) · also ’fell out of’ + gen., of a broken blade (ἔκπεσε χειρός ’fell from the hand’) · also aor. 3 sg., of a man falling from a vehicle, + gen.: ’fell out of’ (ἔκπεσε δίφρου ’fell out of the chariot’)
ἔκτοθι: ἔκτοθι — outside, away from; adv./prep. + gen.: ’outside the ships’
ἔμπνυτο: ἐμπνύω (ἀμπνύω) — recover breath, revive; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’drew breath again’
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with accent thrown back after its noun (νέεσσ’ ἔνι = Attic ἐν ναυσί) · also ἔνι = ἔνεστι, ἔνεισι, accented on the first syllable: ’is in, are in’ (οὔ οἱ ἔνι φρένες ’there are no wits in him’)
ἔπασσε: πάσσω — sprinkle; impf. 3 sg. act., in tmesis with ἐπί: ’sprinkled on’
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
ἔρχεαι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἔρχῃ): ’you go’
ἔσσεαι: εἰμί — be; fut. 2 sg., epic ἔσσεαι (= Attic ἔσῃ): ’you will be’
ἔσταν: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 pl., root aorist, intrans., epic (= Attic ἔστησαν): ’stood’
ἔστη: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg. intrans.: ’stood, took his stand’
ἔτικτε: τίκτω — bear, beget; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’begot’
ἔτρεφε: τρέφω — rear, nurse, bring up; impf. 3 sg. act.
ἔφατο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ἔφη): ’he spoke’
ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον): ’held’ · also ’kept, guarded’ · also ’drove’ (ἔχον ἵππους ’drove the horses’) · also pres. part. act. neut. nom. sg., agreeing with a neuter subject: ’holding’ · also ’had, sustained’ (πόνον ἔχον ’sustained toil’)
ἕδνα: ἕδνον — bridal gift (given to the bride’s kin); neut. acc. pl.
ἕκαστον: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. acc. sg.: ’each (man)’
ἕκτορ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. voc. sg., in address · also masc. acc. sg., epic elided Ἕκτορ’ (= Ἕκτορα), object of σχήσουσι: ’Hector’ (πελώριον Ἕκτορ’ ’huge Hector’) · also masc. dat. sg., elided Ἕκτορ’ (= Ἕκτορι), after ἅμα: ’with Hector’ (ἅμ’ Ἕκτορ’ ἴσαν ’went with Hector’)
ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg., opponent after μάχομαι: ’with Hector’; and after χωρέω: ’to Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. after a verb of anger: ’with Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. with ὑπό, of those before whom men flee: ’before Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. with πειράω, the opponent: ’(make trial) with Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg., the person deprived: ’(taken) from Hector’
ἕκτορος: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam, chief Trojan hero; masc. gen. sg.
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλκον: ἕλκω — drag, draw; pres. part. act. neut. nom. sg., agreeing with φάος: ’drawing’
ἕλοι: αἱρέω — take, seize, capture; aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’would take’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg., in a clause of hoped-for result: ’might catch’ (εἴ τινά … ἕλοι ’to see if he might catch someone’)
ἠετίωνος: Ἠετίων — Eëtion, king of Thebe, father of Andromache; masc. gen. sg. · also Ἠετίων — Eëtion, father of Podes (not said to be the same man); masc. gen. sg., after υἱόν
ἡλικίην: ἡλικία — age, those of one’s own age; fem. acc. sg., epic -ίη (= Attic ἡλικίαν), as object: ’age-mates’
ἡμῖν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; dat. pl. ’to us’
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἣ πληθύς ’the throng’) · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative, subject of a nominal clause: ’this’ · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative for a thing: ’it’ (of a spear)
ἤκουσε: ἀκούω — hear, hear of, heed (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’heard’
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἤριπε: ἐρείπω — throw down; in the intransitive aor. ἤριπον, fall headlong, crash down; aor. 3 sg.: ’fell headlong’
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’ · also relative, fem. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic οἱ: ’who’ (ἥ οἱ … ἰοῦσα ’who, going before him’)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἦτορ: ἦτορ — heart; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. of respect: ’in heart’ (βεβλαμμένον ἦτορ ’stricken in heart’)
ἰδὲ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj. (= Attic καί)
ἰῇ: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; fem. dat. sg. ἰῇ, epic (= Attic μιᾷ): ’one, the same’
ἱστὸν: ἱστός — loom, mast; masc. acc. sg. (here ’loom’, and by extension the web on it) · also ’mast’ (of a ship): ἱστὸν … στῆσαν ἀείραντες ’they raised and set up the mast’
ἴλιος: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. nom. sg.
ἴση: ἴσος — equal, the same; fem. nom. sg.
ἷξεν: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at; aor. 3 sg. ἷξε(ν), movable ν
ὀνομάζων: ὀνομάζω — name, call by name; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg. · also used adverbially: ’sharply’ (ὀξὺ νόησε ’noticed sharply’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with βέλος: ’sharp (shaft)’
ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind, backward, afterwards; adv. (= ὀπίσω)
ὀπὸς: ὀπός — juice, sap (of the fig-tree, used to curdle milk); masc. nom. sg. · also ὄψ, ὀπός — voice; fem. gen. sg., with ἔκλυον: ’the voice (of the son of Atreus)’
ὀρφανικὸν: ὀρφανικός — orphaned, fatherless; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with παῖδα
ὀφθαλμῶν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. gen. pl., after ἀπό: ’from the eyes’ · also masc. gen. pl. after κατά: ’down over the eyes’ (κατ’ ὀφθαλμῶν)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄφελεν: ὀφείλω (ὀφέλλω) — owe, ought; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὤφελε(ν)); with ὡς + inf., an unfulfilled wish: ’would that’ · also aor. 3 sg. + inf. without ὡς, an unfulfilled obligation: ’ought to’ (ὄφελεν … πονέεσθαι ’ought to be toiling’)
ὄφελος: ὄφελος — use, help, advantage; neut. nom. sg., subject
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction: ’in that, because’ (ὅ σφιν ἀμύνω ’in that I ward off from them’)
ὅθ: ὅθι (elided ὅθ’) — where; relative adv. of place · also ὅτε (elided and aspirated ὅθ’) — when; temporal conj.
ὅμιλον: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. acc. sg.
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’) · also ὅς (τε) as an indirect interrogative without τις: ’who’ (ὅς τε πεφεύγοι ’who had fled’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὅττί: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; neut. acc. sg. ὅττι (doubled τ), accented before the enclitic κεν · also ὅττι = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οὐδέ τι ᾔδη ὅττι … ’nor did he know that …’) · also ὅττι = ὅτι, ’that, because’, giving the cause of anger (χώσατο … ὅττι ’was incensed that’) · also ὅττι = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of rejoicing, accented before the enclitic οἱ (γήθησέν τε ὅττί … ’rejoiced that …’) · also ὅττι = ὅ τι, interrogative neut. nom. sg. in an indirect question, agreeing with πένθος: ’what (grief)’
ὑληέσσῃ: ὑλήεις — wooded, forested; fem. dat. sg., epic -έσσῃ (fem. of -εις), agreeing with Πλάκῳ
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’) · also prep. + acc., place where: ’beneath’ (ὑπὸ γαῖαν ’beneath the earth’) · also prep. + φι-form of place: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ ζυγόφι ’from under the yoke’)
ὑψηλοῖο: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ὕφαινε: ὑφαίνω — weave; impf. 3 sg. (an augment on initial υ- does not show in writing): ’was weaving’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤφελλε: ὀφείλω (epic ὀφέλλω) — owe; ought; impf. 3 sg., of what ought not to have been: ’ought’ · also impf. 3 sg. with an inf. in an unfulfilled wish: ’would that it had (not) …’ (ὤφελλε γενέσθαι)
ᾤμωξεν: οἰμώζω — cry out in pain, wail; aor. 3 sg. act.
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
